description_sq:
Apartament 2+1 per shitje tek Rruga Frank Bardhi, prane Eleonores.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare te banimit,
Ka akses te menjehershem ne unazen e madhe.
Organizimi:
Sallon dhe kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet, nje depo dhe ballkon.
Ka nevoje per rinovim.
Gjithashtu disponon dhe nje oborr qe aksesohet vetem nga apartamenti.
Disponon dokumnetacion hipotekor.
Cmimi ne leke.
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Frank Bardhi Street, near Eleonore. The apartment is located on the first floor of the building, with immediate access to the big ring road. Layout: Living room and kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom, a storage room and a balcony. It needs renovation. It also has a yard that can only be accessed from the apartment. Has mortgage documentation. Price in lek.
